it.title: Income tax calculator
it.description: Estimate income tax for an individual under the old and new regimes, including surcharge and cess, for the selected tax year.
it.summary: This tool works out the income tax payable by an individual, with surcharge and health and education cess, under the old and the new regime. It is used by salaried employees, professionals and anyone estimating a tax bill before filing. You need to enter your income under each head, the deductions you claim and the tax year, and the result shows taxable income, tax before and after cess, and the figures for each regime.
steps: Enter your income under each head, the deductions you claim and the tax year.
Choose the regime, age group and tax year to match your situation.
Read taxable income, tax before and after cess, and the figures for each regime in the result.
it.note: Surcharge and cess are shown separately; confirm the slab and rebate for your tax year before filing.

capgains.title: Capital gains tax calculator
capgains.description: Compute short-term and long-term capital gains tax on shares, mutual funds, property and other assets for the selected tax year.
capgains.summary: This tool computes capital gains on the transfer of an asset and the tax on that gain, separating short-term from long-term holdings. It is used by investors selling shares, mutual fund units, property or other capital assets. You need to enter the asset type, purchase and sale dates, cost and sale value, and the result shows the holding period, the gain or loss and the tax at the applicable rate.
steps: Enter the asset type, purchase and sale dates, cost and sale value.
Choose the asset class and the tax year to match your situation.
Read the holding period, the gain or loss and the tax at the applicable rate in the result.
capgains.note: Rates and holding periods differ by asset class; check that you picked the correct class before relying on the result.

sec50aa.title: Section 50AA debt fund calculator
sec50aa.description: Work out the gain on specified mutual funds and market-linked debentures taxed at slab rate with no indexation benefit.
sec50aa.summary: This tool works out the gain on specified mutual fund units and market-linked debentures that are treated as short-term and taxed at the slab rate. It is used by investors in debt-oriented mutual funds and market-linked debentures. You need to enter the purchase date, purchase cost, sale value and your slab rate, and the result shows the gain treated as short-term and the tax at your slab rate.
steps: Enter the purchase date, purchase cost, sale value and your slab rate.
Choose the instrument type and your applicable slab rate to match your situation.
Read the gain treated as short-term and the tax at your slab rate in the result.
sec50aa.note: Whether a fund is a specified mutual fund depends on its asset mix; confirm this from the scheme documents.

hra.title: HRA exemption calculator
hra.description: Calculate house rent allowance exemption from basic salary, rent paid and city, and see the taxable HRA for the selected year.
hra.summary: This tool calculates how much of the house rent allowance received is exempt and how much is taxable, using the lowest of the three prescribed limits. It is used by salaried employees who pay rent and receive HRA. You need to enter basic salary, dearness allowance, HRA received, rent paid and the city of residence, and the result shows the exempt HRA, the taxable HRA and which limit applied.
steps: Enter basic salary, dearness allowance, HRA received, rent paid and the city of residence.
Choose the city category and the period for which you claim to match your situation.
Read the exempt HRA, the taxable HRA and which limit applied in the result.
hra.note: HRA relief is available only under the old regime and needs rent receipts; the landlord PAN is needed for large rent.

advtax.title: Advance tax and interest calculator
advtax.description: Calculate advance tax instalments and the interest for late or short payment for the selected assessment year.
advtax.summary: This tool estimates the advance tax instalments due and the interest for default or deferment of payment, along with interest for late filing. It is used by individuals, professionals and businesses who pay advance tax. You need to enter your estimated tax liability, the dates and amounts of payments made and the filing date, and the result shows the instalment schedule, the shortfall and the interest by section.
steps: Enter your estimated tax liability, the dates and amounts of payments made and the filing date.
Choose the due dates and the assessment year to match your situation.
Read the instalment schedule, the shortfall and the interest by section in the result.
advtax.note: Interest is estimated month by month; actual interest depends on the exact dates of payment and the return filed.

ctc.title: CTC structure and take-home calculator
ctc.description: Break a CTC into salary components and estimate monthly take-home pay under the old and new tax regimes. Uses the figures you enter.
ctc.summary: This tool splits a cost-to-company figure into salary components and estimates the monthly in-hand pay after tax and deductions under each regime. It is used by employees comparing offers and employers designing salary structures. You need to enter the annual CTC, the proposed component split and your investments, and the result shows the monthly take-home pay, the annual tax and a comparison of both regimes.
steps: Enter the annual CTC, the proposed component split and your investments.
Choose the regime and the component amounts to match your situation.
Read the monthly take-home pay, the annual tax and a comparison of both regimes in the result.
ctc.note: Employer contribution and perquisite treatment vary by employer policy; check your offer letter for the actual structure.

gratuity.h1: Gratuity, leave encashment, VRS and pension exemption
gratuity.title: Gratuity, leave, VRS and pension exemption
gratuity.description: Find the tax-exempt part of gratuity, leave encashment, voluntary retirement compensation and commuted pension.
gratuity.summary: This tool finds the exempt and taxable parts of gratuity, leave encashment, voluntary retirement compensation and commuted pension. It is used by retiring or separating employees and pensioners. You need to enter last drawn salary, years of service, leave balance and the amount received, and the result shows the exempt limit, the exempt amount and the taxable balance.
steps: Enter last drawn salary, years of service, leave balance and the amount received.
Choose the type of receipt and whether the employer is covered by the gratuity law to match your situation.
Read the exempt limit, the exempt amount and the taxable balance in the result.
gratuity.note: Exemption limits depend on the employer type and on earlier receipts; confirm these before treating an amount as exempt.

itrpicker.title: ITR form picker
itrpicker.description: Find out which income tax return form, from ITR-1 to ITR-7, applies to your income sources and status. Uses the figures you enter.
itrpicker.summary: This tool helps identify which of the forms ITR-1 to ITR-7 applies, based on the taxpayer's status and sources of income. It is used by individuals, HUFs, firms, companies and trusts about to file a return. You need to enter your status, residence, types of income and whether you have a business or foreign assets, and the result shows the form that appears to apply and the reason for it.
steps: Enter your status, residence, types of income and whether you have a business or foreign assets.
Choose your status and the income types you have to match your situation.
Read the form that appears to apply and the reason for it in the result.
itrpicker.note: The form depends on facts for the whole year; confirm eligibility against the instructions of the relevant return form.

homeloan.title: Home loan interest deduction calculator
homeloan.description: Work out the home loan interest deduction for a self-occupied or let-out house, including pre-construction interest.
homeloan.summary: This tool works out the deduction for home loan interest on a self-occupied or let-out house, including pre-construction interest spread over five years. It is used by home owners with a housing loan. You need to enter the interest paid in the year, the pre-construction interest and whether the house is let out, and the result shows the interest allowed this year and the amount that can be set off against other income.
steps: Enter the interest paid in the year, the pre-construction interest and whether the house is let out.
Choose the property use and the regime to match your situation.
Read the interest allowed this year and the amount that can be set off against other income in the result.
homeloan.note: The cap for self-occupied property and the set-off limit apply per year; confirm the limits for your tax year.

chvia.title: Chapter VI-A deductions calculator
chvia.description: See how much of each Chapter VI-A deduction you have used and the headroom left under the old regime. Uses the figures you enter.
chvia.summary: This tool tracks the amounts claimed under the main Chapter VI-A deductions and shows the headroom left against each limit. It is used by salaried individuals and professionals planning investments under the old regime. You need to enter the amounts invested or paid for each deduction and your age category, and the result shows the claimed amount, the unused limit and the estimated tax effect.
steps: Enter the amounts invested or paid for each deduction and your age category.
Choose your age group and the deductions that apply to you to match your situation.
Read the claimed amount, the unused limit and the estimated tax effect in the result.
chvia.note: Most Chapter VI-A deductions are available only under the old regime; check each limit and eligibility condition.

esop.title: ESOP and RSU tax calculator
esop.description: Estimate tax on ESOP, RSU and sweat equity at exercise as a perquisite and again on sale as capital gain. Uses the figures you enter.
esop.summary: This tool estimates tax in two stages: the perquisite taxed as salary at exercise, and the capital gain on a later sale of the shares. It is used by employees and founders who receive stock options or restricted stock units. You need to enter the exercise cost, the market value at exercise, the sale value and the dates, and the result shows the perquisite value, the capital gain and the tax at each stage.
steps: Enter the exercise cost, the market value at exercise, the sale value and the dates.
Choose the type of shares and your slab rate to match your situation.
Read the perquisite value, the capital gain and the tax at each stage in the result.
esop.note: Valuation of unlisted shares and the treatment of foreign shares need separate checking; use the valuation your employer reports.

buyback.title: Share buyback tax calculator
buyback.description: Estimate tax on a company's share buyback for the selected period, under the rules that applied before and after the recent changes.
buyback.summary: This tool estimates the tax on a share buyback under the three rule sets that have applied over time, based on the buyback date. It is used by shareholders who tender shares in a buyback and companies planning one. You need to enter the buyback date, the consideration received, the cost of the shares and the holding period, and the result shows the taxable amount and the tax under the rules for the chosen date.
steps: Enter the buyback date, the consideration received, the cost of the shares and the holding period.
Choose the shareholder category and the buyback date to match your situation.
Read the taxable amount and the tax under the rules for the chosen date in the result.
buyback.note: The rules changed more than once; confirm the date of the buyback and the treatment in your own return.

dividend.title: Dividend tax and TDS calculator
dividend.description: Estimate tax and TDS on dividend income, and the deduction for dividends passed on, for the selected year. Uses the figures you enter.
dividend.summary: This tool estimates the tax payable on dividend income, the tax deducted at source on it and the deduction for dividend passed on to others. It is used by shareholders and companies that receive and distribute dividends. You need to enter the dividend received, the expenses claimed and your slab rate, and the result shows the taxable dividend, the TDS and the net tax.
steps: Enter the dividend received, the expenses claimed and your slab rate.
Choose the shareholder type and the payment date to match your situation.
Read the taxable dividend, the TDS and the net tax in the result.
dividend.note: TDS is deducted only above the prescribed annual threshold per payer; check the threshold for your tax year.

cgreinvest.title: Capital gain reinvestment planner
cgreinvest.description: Plan the exemption on long-term capital gains by reinvesting in a house, bonds or a new residential property. Uses the figures you enter.
cgreinvest.summary: This tool shows how much of a long-term capital gain can be kept exempt by reinvesting the sale proceeds in a house, specified bonds or another qualifying asset. It is used by taxpayers who have sold property or other long-term assets. You need to enter the capital gain, the net consideration and the amount you plan to reinvest, and the result shows the exempt amount, the taxable balance and the time limits.
steps: Enter the capital gain, the net consideration and the amount you plan to reinvest.
Choose the type of asset sold and the reinvestment route to match your situation.
Read the exempt amount, the taxable balance and the time limits in the result.
cgreinvest.note: Each exemption has its own time limit and conditions; confirm the conditions before investing.

sec54ec.title: Section 54EC capital gain bonds calculator
sec54ec.description: Check the exemption on land or building gains when invested in specified bonds within the permitted period. Uses the figures you enter.
sec54ec.summary: This tool checks how much of a long-term gain on land or building is exempt when invested in specified bonds within the permitted time. It is used by sellers of land or buildings with long-term gains. You need to enter the date of transfer, the gain and the amount invested in the bonds, and the result shows the exempt gain, the taxable balance and the last date to invest.
steps: Enter the date of transfer, the gain and the amount invested in the bonds.
Choose the transfer date and the investment date to match your situation.
Read the exempt gain, the taxable balance and the last date to invest in the result.
sec54ec.note: There is a ceiling on investment per financial year and a lock-in; confirm the current limits before investing.

sec80iac.title: Section 80IAC startup deduction calculator
sec80iac.description: Estimate the profit deduction for an eligible startup over the permitted block of years, based on its profits and years of claim.
sec80iac.summary: This tool estimates the deduction on profits of an eligible startup for the years chosen within the permitted period. It is used by founders and finance teams of recognised startups. You need to enter the year of incorporation, the profits of each year and the years you choose to claim, and the result shows the profit eligible for deduction and the resulting tax saving estimate.
steps: Enter the year of incorporation, the profits of each year and the years you choose to claim.
Choose the claim years and the eligibility details to match your situation.
Read the profit eligible for deduction and the resulting tax saving estimate in the result.
sec80iac.note: Eligibility needs recognition and a certificate from the competent authority; confirm each condition before claiming.

sec54gb.title: Section 54GB property to startup calculator
sec54gb.description: Check the exemption on gains from residential property sold and invested in the shares of an eligible startup company.
sec54gb.summary: This tool checks the exemption on the gain from the sale of a residential property when the net consideration is invested in shares of an eligible company. It is used by individuals and HUFs who sold a residential property. You need to enter the sale value, the cost, the net consideration and the amount subscribed in shares, and the result shows the exempt gain, the taxable balance and the key dates.
steps: Enter the sale value, the cost, the net consideration and the amount subscribed in shares.
Choose the date of sale and the investment details to match your situation.
Read the exempt gain, the taxable balance and the key dates in the result.
sec54gb.note: The scheme has time limits and a lock-in on the shares; confirm that the company meets the conditions.

sec54b.title: Section 54B agricultural land exemption
sec54b.description: Calculate the exemption on gains from selling agricultural land when you buy new agricultural land within the prescribed period.
sec54b.summary: This tool calculates the exemption on the capital gain from the transfer of agricultural land when new agricultural land is bought within the time allowed. It is used by individuals and HUFs who sold agricultural land that was used for farming. You need to enter the capital gain, the amount spent on new land and the dates of sale and purchase, and the result shows the exempt amount, the taxable gain and the date by which to reinvest.
steps: Enter the capital gain, the amount spent on new land and the dates of sale and purchase.
Choose the dates and the amount reinvested to match your situation.
Read the exempt amount, the taxable gain and the date by which to reinvest in the result.
sec54b.note: Land must have been used for agriculture before sale; unused money may need to be placed in a deposit account.

slumpsale.title: Slump sale capital gains calculator
slumpsale.description: Compute the capital gain on a slump sale from the consideration and the net worth of the undertaking transferred.
slumpsale.summary: This tool computes the capital gain on a slump sale by deducting the net worth of the undertaking from the lump-sum consideration. It is used by business owners and companies selling an undertaking as a going concern. You need to enter the lump-sum consideration, the net worth of the undertaking and the date of the business start, and the result shows the net worth, the capital gain and its short-term or long-term nature.
steps: Enter the lump-sum consideration, the net worth of the undertaking and the date of the business start.
Choose the holding period of the undertaking to match your situation.
Read the net worth, the capital gain and its short-term or long-term nature in the result.
slumpsale.note: Net worth follows a prescribed method and needs a certificate from an accountant; do not use rough accounting values.

sec43ca.title: Section 43CA stamp duty value calculator
sec43ca.description: Check the stamp duty value deemed as sale value when a builder or developer sells property held as stock-in-trade.
sec43ca.summary: This tool checks whether the stamp duty value of a property held as stock-in-trade is taken as the sale value, using the permitted tolerance band. It is used by builders, developers and buyers of such properties. You need to enter the agreement value and the stamp duty value of the property, and the result shows the value adopted for tax and any difference from the agreed value.
steps: Enter the agreement value and the stamp duty value of the property.
Choose the date of agreement and of registration to match your situation.
Read the value adopted for tax and any difference from the agreed value in the result.
sec43ca.note: The tolerance and the date for the stamp duty value depend on the facts of the sale; check the agreement and registration dates.

sec40a.title: TDS disallowance, Section 40(a)
sec40a.description: Estimate the expense disallowed when tax was not deducted or deposited on time, for a resident or non-resident payee.
sec40a.summary: This tool estimates the part of an expense that is disallowed when tax was not deducted or was not deposited on time, for resident and non-resident payees. It is used by businesses and professionals whose accounts are audited. You need to enter the expense amount, the TDS applicable and the dates of deduction and deposit, and the result shows the disallowed amount and the stage at which it can be claimed later.
steps: Enter the expense amount, the TDS applicable and the dates of deduction and deposit.
Choose the payee type and the dates to match your situation.
Read the disallowed amount and the stage at which it can be claimed later in the result.
sec40a.note: An expense disallowed can be claimed in a later year when tax is paid; check the conditions in the provision.

sec10aa.title: Section 10AA SEZ deduction calculator
sec10aa.description: Estimate the profit deduction for a unit in a Special Economic Zone over the years of the tax holiday. Uses the figures you enter.
sec10aa.summary: This tool estimates the deduction on export profits of a unit in a Special Economic Zone across the years of the holiday. It is used by SEZ units and their finance teams. You need to enter the export turnover, the total turnover, the profit and the year of operation, and the result shows the deduction allowed for the year and the profit that remains taxable.
steps: Enter the export turnover, the total turnover, the profit and the year of operation.
Choose the year of the unit's operation to match your situation.
Read the deduction allowed for the year and the profit that remains taxable in the result.
sec10aa.note: The deduction is available only to units that began operations within the specified dates; check eligibility first.

sec14a.title: Section 14A exempt income disallowance
sec14a.description: Compute the expenditure disallowed against exempt income using the prescribed formula on average investments. Uses the figures you enter.
sec14a.summary: This tool computes the expenditure disallowed for earning exempt income, using the prescribed formula based on average investments in exempt assets. It is used by businesses, companies and individuals with exempt income. You need to enter the exempt income, the investments at the start and end of the year and the expenses claimed, and the result shows the average investment, the amount disallowed and the amount allowed.
steps: Enter the exempt income, the investments at the start and end of the year and the expenses claimed.
Choose the method used and any direct expenses to match your situation.
Read the average investment, the amount disallowed and the amount allowed in the result.
sec14a.note: The formula applies where the assessing officer is not satisfied with the claim; check the facts of your case.

surcharge.title: Surcharge and marginal relief calculator
surcharge.description: Calculate surcharge by income band and the marginal relief at each threshold for individuals and HUFs. Uses the figures you enter.
surcharge.summary: This tool calculates the surcharge on income tax by income band, together with the marginal relief that applies at each threshold. It is used by high-income individuals and HUFs. You need to enter the total income, any income taxed at special rates and the regime, and the result shows the surcharge, the marginal relief and the tax with cess.
steps: Enter the total income, any income taxed at special rates and the regime.
Choose the regime and the tax year to match your situation.
Read the surcharge, the marginal relief and the tax with cess in the result.
surcharge.note: Surcharge on some special-rate income is capped; confirm the cap that applies to each type of income.

sec115ad.title: FPI tax calculator under Section 115AD
sec115ad.description: Estimate tax on income of a foreign portfolio investor at the special rates applied on a gross basis. Uses the figures you enter.
sec115ad.summary: This tool estimates tax on the income of a foreign portfolio investor at the special rates, applied on a gross basis without deductions. It is used by foreign portfolio investors and their tax advisers. You need to enter the type and amount of each income and the gains on securities, and the result shows the tax by type of income, the surcharge and the total.
steps: Enter the type and amount of each income and the gains on securities.
Choose the type of income and any treaty rate to match your situation.
Read the tax by type of income, the surcharge and the total in the result.
sec115ad.note: A treaty may give a lower rate; check the treaty and the documents needed to claim it.

sec94b.title: Thin capitalisation limit calculator
sec94b.description: Find how much interest paid to foreign associated enterprises is limited under the thin capitalisation rule. Uses the figures you enter.
sec94b.summary: This tool finds how much interest paid to non-resident associated enterprises can be claimed, using a share of earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation. It is used by companies with cross-border borrowing from related parties. You need to enter the interest expense, the EBITDA and the borrowing from associated enterprises, and the result shows the allowed interest, the excess interest and the carry forward.
steps: Enter the interest expense, the EBITDA and the borrowing from associated enterprises.
Choose the lender type to match your situation.
Read the allowed interest, the excess interest and the carry forward in the result.
sec94b.note: Excess interest can be carried forward for a limited period; confirm eligibility and the carry-forward rules.

sec43b.h1: Statutory dues allowed on payment basis
sec43b.title: Statutory dues on payment basis
sec43b.description: Check which statutory dues are allowed only when paid, and the effect on taxable profit for the year. Uses the figures you enter.
sec43b.summary: This tool checks which statutory dues are allowed as a deduction only in the year of payment and shows the effect on taxable profit. It is used by businesses and professionals who keep accounts on the mercantile basis. You need to enter the dues provided in accounts and the dates and amounts actually paid, and the result shows the allowed amount, the disallowed amount and the amount allowed later.
steps: Enter the dues provided in accounts and the dates and amounts actually paid.
Choose the type of due and the payment date to match your situation.
Read the allowed amount, the disallowed amount and the amount allowed later in the result.
sec43b.note: Payment before the due date of filing the return is normally the test; confirm the date for each item.

sec234f.h1: Late filing fee calculator for Section 234F
sec234f.title: Late filing fee calculator for Section 234F
sec234f.description: Calculate the fee for filing an income tax return after the due date, with interest for delay on the unpaid tax.
sec234f.summary: This tool calculates the fee for filing a return after the due date and the interest for delay on the tax that remained unpaid. It is used by taxpayers who missed the due date for filing their return. You need to enter the total income, the tax payable, the due date and the actual or expected filing date, and the result shows the fee, the interest for delay and the total extra cost.
steps: Enter the total income, the tax payable, the due date and the actual or expected filing date.
Choose the income band and the number of days of delay to match your situation.
Read the fee, the interest for delay and the total extra cost in the result.
sec234f.note: The fee depends on the total income; also check the interest on unpaid tax and the last date allowed for a belated return.

sec234d.title: Interest on excess refund calculator
sec234d.description: Estimate the interest payable by a taxpayer when a refund granted earlier is found to be excessive on assessment.
sec234d.summary: This tool estimates the interest payable by a taxpayer where a refund granted earlier is found to be more than due at the regular assessment. It is used by taxpayers who received an intimation refund and then faced an assessment. You need to enter the refund received, the excess found and the months between refund and assessment, and the result shows the excess refund, the interest and the total amount due back.
steps: Enter the refund received, the excess found and the months between refund and assessment.
Choose the dates of refund and assessment to match your situation.
Read the excess refund, the interest and the total amount due back in the result.
sec234d.note: Part months are counted as full months; confirm the period from the date of the refund.

sec244a.title: Interest on refund calculator
sec244a.description: Estimate the interest the Department pays on a refund of excess tax, TDS or advance tax for the delay period. Uses the figures you enter.
sec244a.summary: This tool estimates the interest paid by the Department on a refund of excess advance tax, TDS or self-assessment tax. It is used by taxpayers waiting for a refund. You need to enter the refund amount, the date of payment and the date of the refund, and the result shows the interest period, the interest and the total refund.
steps: Enter the refund amount, the date of payment and the date of the refund.
Choose the type of tax paid and the period to match your situation.
Read the interest period, the interest and the total refund in the result.
sec244a.note: The start of the interest period differs by type of payment; confirm the dates from your tax statements.

p10a.title: Pension commutation exemption
p10a.description: Find the tax-free portion of a lump sum received for commuting a part of pension. Based on the details you enter.
p10a.summary: This tool finds the exempt and taxable parts of a lump sum received in exchange for giving up a portion of the pension. It is used by retired employees who receive a pension. You need to enter the commuted amount, the percentage commuted and whether gratuity is received, and the result shows the exempt part and the taxable part of the lump sum.
steps: Enter the commuted amount, the percentage commuted and whether gratuity is received.
Choose whether you are a government employee to match your situation.
Read the exempt part and the taxable part of the lump sum in the result.
p10a.note: The exemption differs for government and other employees; confirm your employer category.

sec112a.h1: LTCG on listed equity shares calculator
sec112a.title: LTCG on listed equity shares calculator
sec112a.description: Compute long-term capital gains tax on listed equity shares and equity fund units, including the annual exempt limit.
sec112a.summary: This tool computes long-term capital gains on listed equity shares and units of equity-oriented funds, after the annual exempt limit. It is used by investors who hold listed shares and equity mutual funds for more than a year. You need to enter the purchase cost, the sale value, the dates and any grandfathering value, and the result shows the long-term gain, the exempt part and the tax.
steps: Enter the purchase cost, the sale value, the dates and any grandfathering value.
Choose the dates of purchase and sale to match your situation.
Read the long-term gain, the exempt part and the tax in the result.
sec112a.note: Only transactions subject to securities transaction tax qualify in most cases; confirm the conditions.

ltcgharvest.title: Equity LTCG harvesting calculator
ltcgharvest.description: Estimate how much long-term equity gain to realise each year to use the annual exemption limit. Uses the figures you enter.
ltcgharvest.summary: This tool estimates how much long-term gain from equity holdings could be realised in a year to make use of the annual exemption limit. It is used by investors with large unrealised gains in equity shares or funds. You need to enter the current holdings, their cost, the present value and the gains already realised, and the result shows the unused exemption, the gain that can be harvested and the tax effect.
steps: Enter the current holdings, their cost, the present value and the gains already realised.
Choose the financial year and the holdings considered to match your situation.
Read the unused exemption, the gain that can be harvested and the tax effect in the result.
ltcgharvest.note: Selling and rebuying has a cost and a market risk; check these before acting on the estimate.

sec111a.h1: STCG on listed equity shares calculator
sec111a.title: STCG on listed equity shares calculator
sec111a.description: Compute short-term capital gains tax on listed equity shares and equity fund units held for a short period. Uses the figures you enter.
sec111a.summary: This tool computes short-term capital gains on listed equity shares and equity-oriented funds sold within the short-term holding period. It is used by traders and investors who sell shares within a year. You need to enter the purchase cost, the sale value, the expenses on transfer and the dates, and the result shows the short-term gain and the tax at the applicable rate.
steps: Enter the purchase cost, the sale value, the expenses on transfer and the dates.
Choose the dates of purchase and sale to match your situation.
Read the short-term gain and the tax at the applicable rate in the result.
sec111a.note: Frequent trading can be treated as business income instead; check how your activity is classified.

sec89.title: Section 89(1) arrears relief calculator
sec89.description: Calculate relief on salary arrears or advance salary received, by spreading the amount over the years it relates to.
sec89.summary: This tool calculates the relief on salary received in arrears or in advance by spreading it over the years to which it relates. It is used by salaried employees who received arrears. You need to enter the arrears for each year, the salary of each year and the tax already paid, and the result shows the tax on the arrears in each year, the extra tax and the relief.
steps: Enter the arrears for each year, the salary of each year and the tax already paid.
Choose the years to which the arrears relate to match your situation.
Read the tax on the arrears in each year, the extra tax and the relief in the result.
sec89.note: The relief is claimed through a prescribed form; no relief arises where the difference is negative.

sec80gg.title: Section 80GG rent deduction calculator
sec80gg.description: Check the rent deduction for tenants who receive no HRA, based on the lowest of the three prescribed limits. Uses the figures you enter.
sec80gg.summary: This tool checks the deduction for rent paid by a person who receives no house rent allowance, using the lowest of the prescribed limits. It is used by self-employed persons and employees without HRA. You need to enter the rent paid in the year, the adjusted total income and the months of rent, and the result shows the deduction allowed and the limit that applied.
steps: Enter the rent paid in the year, the adjusted total income and the months of rent.
Choose the rent months and your property ownership to match your situation.
Read the deduction allowed and the limit that applied in the result.
sec80gg.note: You must not own residential property at the place of work and must file the prescribed form; confirm the conditions.

ewb.title: E-way bill requirement checker

ewb.summary: This tool checks whether an e-way bill is needed for a movement of goods by testing the value of the consignment and the type of movement. It is used by suppliers, transporters and recipients of goods. You need to enter the value of the goods, the type of movement and the goods transported, and the result shows whether an e-way bill is required and the validity period.
steps: Enter the value of the goods, the type of movement and the goods transported.
Choose whether the movement is within or outside the state to match your situation.
Read whether an e-way bill is required and the validity period in the result.
ewb.note: Exemptions and state limits apply; check the rules for the goods and states concerned.

pos.title: GST place of supply checker
pos.description: Find the place of supply for goods or services to decide whether the supply is within a state or between states.
pos.summary: This tool finds the place of supply of goods or services to decide whether the supply is an intra-state or an inter-state supply. It is used by GST registered businesses and their accountants. You need to enter the location of the supplier and the recipient, the type of supply and the delivery location, and the result shows the place of supply and whether CGST and SGST or IGST applies.
steps: Enter the location of the supplier and the recipient, the type of supply and the delivery location.
Choose the nature of the supply to match your situation.
Read the place of supply and whether CGST and SGST or IGST applies in the result.
pos.note: Special rules apply to services such as immovable property and transport; check them for your transaction.

optimizer.title: Tax saving optimizer
optimizer.description: Plan how to use deductions across investments, insurance and home loan, and compare the old and new regimes. Uses the figures you enter.
optimizer.summary: This tool plans how to use the deduction limits across investments, insurance, pension and home loan, and compares the old and the new regime. It is used by salaried individuals planning their tax-saving investments. You need to enter the income, the deductions you can use, the investments planned and your risk profile, and the result shows a suggested spread of deductions and the regime that results in lower tax.
steps: Enter the income, the deductions you can use, the investments planned and your risk profile.
Choose your age and risk preference to match your situation.
Read a suggested spread of deductions and the regime that results in lower tax in the result.
optimizer.note: This is a planning aid and not advice on a product; check that each investment suits your finances.

sec80tta.title: Section 80TTA and 80TTB deduction
sec80tta.description: Check the deduction for interest on savings accounts and, for senior citizens, deposits, under the old regime.
sec80tta.summary: This tool checks the deduction for interest on savings accounts and, for senior citizens, on deposits, under the old regime. It is used by depositors and senior citizens with interest income. You need to enter the interest from savings accounts, fixed deposits and post office deposits, and the result shows the deduction allowed and the interest left taxable.
steps: Enter the interest from savings accounts, fixed deposits and post office deposits.
Choose your age group to match your situation.
Read the deduction allowed and the interest left taxable in the result.
sec80tta.note: These deductions are not allowed under the new regime; confirm the age test and the types of interest covered.

equalisation.title: Equalisation levy calculator
equalisation.description: Compute the equalisation levy on online advertising and digital services paid to non-residents, where applicable.
equalisation.summary: This tool computes the equalisation levy on payments to non-residents for online advertising and digital services, where the levy applies. It is used by businesses that pay non-residents for digital services. You need to enter the amount paid, the type of service and the date of payment, and the result shows the levy at the applicable rate and the due date for payment.
steps: Enter the amount paid, the type of service and the date of payment.
Choose the type of service to match your situation.
Read the levy at the applicable rate and the due date for payment in the result.
equalisation.note: The scope of the levy has changed over time; confirm what applies to the date of your payment.

sec89a.title: Foreign retirement benefit tax, Section 89A
sec89a.description: Estimate the tax treatment of foreign retirement accounts such as 401(k) and UK pension for resident Indians. Uses the figures you enter.
sec89a.summary: This tool estimates how income from foreign retirement accounts is taxed, with the option of tax deferral for residents of India. It is used by residents of India who hold accounts in the USA, UK or Canada. You need to enter the account balance, the income accrued and the year of withdrawal, and the result shows the income taxable in the year and the income deferred.
steps: Enter the account balance, the income accrued and the year of withdrawal.
Choose the country of the account to match your situation.
Read the income taxable in the year and the income deferred in the result.
sec89a.note: The relief depends on notified countries and accounts; confirm that your account is covered.

sec80gga.h1: Research and rural donation deduction, Section 80GGA
sec80gga.title: Section 80GGA donation deduction
sec80gga.description: Check the deduction for donations to scientific research and rural development for taxpayers without business income.
sec80gga.summary: This tool checks the deduction for donations to scientific research and rural development, available to taxpayers who have no business income. It is used by individuals and others who donate to approved institutions. You need to enter the donation made, the recipient institution and the mode of payment, and the result shows the deduction allowed and the amount not eligible.
steps: Enter the donation made, the recipient institution and the mode of payment.
Choose the institution type to match your situation.
Read the deduction allowed and the amount not eligible in the result.
sec80gga.note: Cash donations above a stated limit are not allowed; confirm the approval of the recipient.

sec80ee.title: First home interest deduction, Section 80EE
sec80ee.description: Check the older extra deduction on home loan interest for a first home in the specified loan year. Uses the figures you enter.
sec80ee.summary: This tool checks the older extra deduction on home loan interest for a first-time buyer for loans sanctioned in the stated year. It is used by borrowers who still claim the benefit. You need to enter the loan sanction date, the loan and property values, and the interest paid, and the result shows the deduction available this year and the limit.
steps: Enter the loan sanction date, the loan and property values, and the interest paid.
Choose the year of loan sanction to match your situation.
Read the deduction available this year and the limit in the result.
sec80ee.note: This applies only to loans sanctioned in a window that has closed; it helps existing claims only.

p44ada.title: Section 44ADA presumptive tax
p44ada.description: Estimate presumptive income for specified professionals at a fixed share of receipts and compare it with actual profit.
p44ada.summary: This tool estimates the presumptive income of a specified professional at a fixed share of gross receipts and compares it with the actual profit. It is used by doctors, lawyers, architects, engineers, accountants and similar professionals. You need to enter the gross receipts, the actual expenses and the profit as per accounts, and the result shows the deemed income, the actual income and the difference.
steps: Enter the gross receipts, the actual expenses and the profit as per accounts.
Choose the receipts limit that applies to you to match your situation.
Read the deemed income, the actual income and the difference in the result.
p44ada.note: Receipt limits depend on the mode of receipt; if you claim lower income, a tax audit may follow.

p44ae.h1: Presumptive tax for goods carriages, Section 44AE
p44ae.title: Section 44AE presumptive tax
p44ae.description: Estimate the presumptive income of a goods carriage owner on a per-vehicle basis for the year. Uses the figures you enter.
p44ae.summary: This tool estimates the presumptive income of an owner of goods vehicles, calculated per vehicle for the months of ownership. It is used by owners of up to ten goods carriages. You need to enter the number of vehicles, the tonnage of each, and the months of ownership, and the result shows the deemed income per vehicle and the total.
steps: Enter the number of vehicles, the tonnage of each, and the months of ownership.
Choose whether the vehicle is heavy or other to match your situation.
Read the deemed income per vehicle and the total in the result.
p44ae.note: The scheme is not available above a stated number of vehicles; the owner can still claim a higher actual income.

ptax.title: Professional tax calculator by state
ptax.description: Find the professional tax payable on salary in each state, deducted by the employer and remitted to the state.
ptax.summary: This tool finds the professional tax deducted by the employer on salary, using the slabs of the state concerned. It is used by salaried employees and employers. You need to enter the monthly salary and the state of work, and the result shows the monthly and annual professional tax.
steps: Enter the monthly salary and the state of work.
Choose the state and the pay period to match your situation.
Read the monthly and annual professional tax in the result.
ptax.note: Slabs differ by state and can change; verify the current slab with the state department.

bonus.title: Statutory bonus calculator
bonus.description: Calculate the statutory bonus under the Payment of Bonus Act, with the minimum and maximum percentages and wage ceiling.
bonus.summary: This tool calculates the bonus due under the Payment of Bonus Act, applying the minimum and maximum percentages and the wage ceiling. It is used by employers and employees in covered establishments. You need to enter the basic pay, dearness allowance, months worked and the bonus percentage, and the result shows the bonus payable and the allocable surplus test.
steps: Enter the basic pay, dearness allowance, months worked and the bonus percentage.
Choose the percentage and the wage ceiling used to match your situation.
Read the bonus payable and the allocable surplus test in the result.
bonus.note: Coverage depends on the size of the establishment; confirm that the law applies and check state notifications.

esi.title: ESI contribution calculator
esi.description: Compute employer and employee contributions under the Employees' State Insurance Act on monthly wages. Uses the figures you enter.
esi.summary: This tool computes the employer and employee contributions under the Employees' State Insurance Act on the monthly wages. It is used by employers and payroll teams. You need to enter the monthly wages and the number of employees, and the result shows the employee share, the employer share and the total contribution.
steps: Enter the monthly wages and the number of employees.
Choose the month and the wage ceiling to match your situation.
Read the employee share, the employer share and the total contribution in the result.
esi.note: Coverage depends on the wage ceiling and the establishment; confirm current rates with the corporation.

epfdmg.h1: EPF and ESI late payment damages calculator
epfdmg.title: EPF and ESI late payment damages
epfdmg.description: Estimate damages on late deposit of provident fund and state insurance contributions, at the graded rates. Uses the figures you enter.
epfdmg.summary: This tool estimates the damages charged on late deposit of provident fund and employee insurance contributions, using the graded rates by days of delay. It is used by employers who deposit contributions late. You need to enter the amount of contribution, the due date and the date of deposit, and the result shows the days of delay, the rate and the damages.
steps: Enter the amount of contribution, the due date and the date of deposit.
Select the scheme from the options that apply to your case.
Read the days of delay, the rate and the damages in the result.
epfdmg.note: The damages are assessed by the authority and may differ; interest is charged separately.

scencompare.title: Tax scenario comparison tool
scencompare.description: Compare up to four tax scenarios with different regimes, deductions and incomes, side by side. Uses the figures you enter.
scencompare.summary: This tool compares up to four tax scenarios side by side, each with its own regime, deductions and income mix. It is used by individuals and advisers choosing between options. You need to enter the income, the deductions and the regime for each scenario, and the result shows the tax for each scenario and the gap between the highest and lowest.
steps: Enter the income, the deductions and the regime for each scenario.
Choose the regime for each scenario to match your situation.
Read the tax for each scenario and the gap between the highest and lowest in the result.
scencompare.note: The comparison depends entirely on the inputs; verify each scenario against your facts.

gst.title: GST calculator
gst.description: Add or remove GST from an amount, split it into CGST, SGST and IGST, and check input tax credit that is blocked.
gst.summary: This tool adds or removes GST from an amount, splits the tax into CGST, SGST and IGST, and checks the composition scheme and blocked input tax credit. It is used by business owners, accountants and consumers. You need to enter the amount, the GST rate and whether the amount includes tax, and the result shows the taxable value, the tax split and the total.
steps: Enter the amount, the GST rate and whether the amount includes tax.
Choose the rate and the type of supply to match your situation.
Read the taxable value, the tax split and the total in the result.
gst.note: Rates depend on the goods or service; confirm the rate against the current notification.

invoice.title: GST tax invoice generator
invoice.description: Prepare a GST tax invoice with automatic numbering, tax split and details of the buyer and seller. Uses the figures you enter.
invoice.summary: This tool prepares a GST tax invoice with automatic numbering, place of supply taken from the GSTIN and the tax split on each line. It is used by small businesses and professionals who register under GST. You need to enter the details of the seller and buyer, the items, quantities, rates and the tax rate, and the result shows a printable invoice with the tax split and totals.
steps: Enter the details of the seller and buyer, the items, quantities, rates and the tax rate.
Choose the items and the tax rates to match your situation.
Read a printable invoice with the tax split and totals in the result.
invoice.note: This is a drafting aid; check the mandatory details and whether e-invoicing applies.

hsn.title: HSN and SAC code lookup
hsn.description: Search HSN and SAC codes and the GST rate that applies, for the more common goods and services. Uses the figures you enter.
hsn.summary: This tool searches a list of commonly used HSN and SAC codes and shows the GST rate attached to each. It is used by businesses classifying goods and services for GST. You need to enter a keyword or a code, and the result shows the code, its description and the GST rate.
steps: Enter a keyword or a code in the fields provided.
Choose a filter by goods or services to match your situation.
Read the code, its description and the GST rate in the result.
hsn.note: The list is selective and rates change by notification; confirm the code and rate from official sources.

gst2b.title: GSTR-2B reconciliation tool
gst2b.description: Match your purchase register with GSTR-2B to find mismatches in input tax credit before filing. Uses the figures you enter.
gst2b.summary: This tool compares your purchase register with the data in GSTR-2B and flags the invoices that do not match. It is used by businesses and accountants who file GST returns. You need to enter the rows from GSTR-2B and from your purchase register, and the result shows the matched invoices, the mismatches and the input tax credit at risk.
steps: Enter the rows from GSTR-2B and from your purchase register.
Choose the matching basis to match your situation.
Read the matched invoices, the mismatches and the input tax credit at risk in the result.
gst2b.note: The check runs on what you paste in; confirm each mismatch with the supplier.

gstrefund.title: GST refund calculator
gstrefund.description: Compute GST refund for exports and inverted duty structures using the prescribed formulae. Uses the figures you enter.
gstrefund.summary: This tool computes the refund of GST on exports and on an inverted duty structure using the prescribed formulae. It is used by exporters and manufacturers with credit accumulation. You need to enter the turnover of zero-rated supplies, the input tax credit and the tax paid, and the result shows the maximum refund and the formula used.
steps: Enter the turnover of zero-rated supplies, the input tax credit and the tax paid.
Choose the type of refund to match your situation.
Read the maximum refund and the formula used in the result.
gstrefund.note: Refund is subject to time limits and documents; the officer decides the final amount.

gstr9.title: GSTR-9 and 9C applicability checker
gstr9.description: Check whether the GST annual return and reconciliation statement apply to your turnover, and the due date. Uses the figures you enter.
gstr9.summary: This tool checks whether the GST annual return and the reconciliation statement apply, based on the aggregate turnover and registration. It is used by GST registered taxpayers and their accountants. You need to enter the aggregate turnover for the year and the number of states registered, and the result shows which annual return is needed and the turnover thresholds.
steps: Enter the aggregate turnover for the year and the number of states registered.
Choose the financial year to match your situation.
Read which annual return is needed and the turnover thresholds in the result.
gstr9.note: Thresholds and optional filing depend on the year; check the notification for that year.

gstrlf.h1: GST late fee and interest calculator
gstrlf.title: GST late fee and interest calculator
gstrlf.description: Compute the GST late fee for GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B and the interest on late payment of tax separately. Uses the figures you enter.
gstrlf.summary: This tool computes the late fee for delayed GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B returns and the interest on late payment of tax, treating the two delays separately. It is used by GST registered taxpayers who file late. You need to enter the due date, the filing date, the tax payable and the type of return, and the result shows the late fee for each return, the interest and the total.
steps: Enter the due date, the filing date, the tax payable and the type of return.
Choose the type of return and whether there was tax to match your situation.
Read the late fee for each return, the interest and the total in the result.
gstrlf.note: Fee caps depend on the turnover and the type of return; confirm the cap for the period.

gstint.title: GST interest calculator, Section 50
gstint.description: Calculate interest on late payment of GST and on excess input tax credit taken and used. Uses the figures you enter.
gstint.summary: This tool calculates interest on GST paid late and interest on excess input tax credit claimed or reversed late. It is used by registered taxpayers who pay GST after the due date. You need to enter the amount of tax or credit and the number of days of delay, and the result shows the interest and the total payable.
steps: Enter the amount of tax or credit and the number of days of delay.
Choose the interest rate for the type of default to match your situation.
Read the interest and the total payable in the result.
gstint.note: Interest on credit applies only when it was used; confirm the days between the due date and payment.

qrmp.title: QRMP scheme eligibility checker
qrmp.description: Check eligibility for quarterly returns with monthly payments, and the schedule of returns and payments. Uses the figures you enter.
qrmp.summary: This tool checks eligibility for the scheme of quarterly returns with monthly payment of tax and shows the schedule. It is used by small taxpayers registered under GST. You need to enter the aggregate turnover and the current filing frequency, and the result shows whether you can opt in and the schedule of filing and payment.
steps: Enter the aggregate turnover and the current filing frequency.
Select the quarter from the options that apply to your case.
Read whether you can opt in and the schedule of filing and payment in the result.
qrmp.note: A taxpayer must opt in; confirm the conditions and the dates for the quarter.

regst.title: GST on real estate calculator
regst.description: Estimate the GST rate on residential and commercial property sales and how input tax credit is treated. Uses the figures you enter.
regst.summary: This tool estimates the GST rate on the sale of residential and commercial units under construction and the treatment of input tax credit. It is used by builders and buyers of real estate. You need to enter the value of the sale, the type of unit, the carpet area and the date of the project, and the result shows the GST rate, the tax amount and the credit position.
steps: Enter the value of the sale, the type of unit, the carpet area and the date of the project.
Choose the project type to match your situation.
Read the GST rate, the tax amount and the credit position in the result.
regst.note: Rates and the land deduction depend on the project and the date; check the notification.

einvoice.title: GST e-invoice applicability checker
einvoice.description: Check whether e-invoicing is mandatory for your business based on turnover and the type of invoice. Uses the figures you enter.
einvoice.summary: This tool checks whether you need to generate an invoice reference number from the portal, based on aggregate turnover and the invoice type. It is used by registered businesses issuing B2B and export invoices. You need to enter the aggregate turnover and the type of supplies, and the result shows whether e-invoicing applies and the threshold used.
steps: Enter the aggregate turnover and the type of supplies.
Choose the year of turnover to match your situation.
Read whether e-invoicing applies and the threshold used in the result.
einvoice.note: The threshold has been reduced over time; confirm the limit that applies from the date of your invoice.

gstcndn.h1: GST credit note and debit note time limit
gstcndn.title: GST credit and debit note time limits
gstcndn.description: Check the last date to issue a credit note and the time to reflect a debit note under GST. Uses the figures you enter.
gstcndn.summary: This tool checks the last date to issue a credit note and the timing for debit notes under the GST law. It is used by GST registered suppliers. You need to enter the date of the original invoice and the date of the note, and the result shows the last date allowed and the treatment of input tax credit.
steps: Enter the date of the original invoice and the date of the note.
Choose the type of note to match your situation.
Read the last date allowed and the treatment of input tax credit in the result.
gstcndn.note: The time limit depends on the financial year of supply; confirm it with the current provisions.

gta.h1: GST on goods transport agency services
gta.title: GST on goods transport agency services
gta.description: Check GST on goods transport agency services at the default rate and the reverse charge, based on the option chosen.
gta.summary: This tool checks the GST on services of a goods transport agency, showing the rate options and who pays under the reverse charge. It is used by transport agencies and their business customers. You need to enter the freight value, the option for the rate and the status of the recipient, and the result shows the tax rate, who pays it and the input tax credit position.
steps: Enter the freight value, the option for the rate and the status of the recipient.
Choose the option for the rate to match your situation.
Read the tax rate, who pays it and the input tax credit position in the result.
gta.note: The option has to be exercised in time; check the conditions of each option.

importsvc.h1: GST on import of services calculator
importsvc.title: GST on import of services calculator
importsvc.description: Calculate the integrated GST payable by the recipient on services received from outside India and the credit. Uses the figures you enter.
importsvc.summary: This tool calculates the integrated GST payable by the recipient on services imported from a supplier outside India, and the related input credit. It is used by businesses that pay foreign suppliers for services. You need to enter the value of the services, the rate of GST and the date of supply, and the result shows the tax payable under reverse charge and the credit available.
steps: Enter the value of the services, the rate of GST and the date of supply.
Choose the nature of the service to match your situation.
Read the tax payable under reverse charge and the credit available in the result.
importsvc.note: Imports from related persons may be valued differently; check the rules for the transaction.

tds.title: TDS calculator and rate finder
tds.description: Find the TDS rate, threshold and tax to deduct for a payment, across the common sections, for the selected year.
tds.summary: This tool finds the rate of tax to be deducted at source on a payment, the threshold and the tax to deduct, across the common sections. It is used by deductors, accountants and payers of salary and other sums. You need to enter the section, the amount paid and the status of the payee, and the result shows the rate, the threshold and the TDS amount.
steps: Enter the section, the amount paid and the status of the payee.
Choose the nature of payment and the payee status to match your situation.
Read the rate, the threshold and the TDS amount in the result.
tds.note: A higher rate applies where the PAN is not furnished; confirm the rate and threshold for the date of payment.

tcs.title: TCS calculator, Section 206C
tcs.description: Calculate tax collected at source on specified sales and receipts, and the rate that applies to the transaction.
tcs.summary: This tool calculates the tax collected at source on specified transactions, with the rate and threshold for each category. It is used by sellers who collect tax and buyers who pay it. You need to enter the amount of the sale or receipt and the category of the transaction, and the result shows the rate, the TCS amount and the amount after collection.
steps: Enter the amount of the sale or receipt and the category of the transaction.
Choose the category and the buyer status to match your situation.
Read the rate, the TCS amount and the amount after collection in the result.
tcs.note: A higher rate applies without a PAN; the TCS shows in Form 26AS and can be claimed as credit.

tdslate.h1: TDS late filing fee and interest calculator
tdslate.title: TDS late filing fee and interest calculator
tdslate.description: Estimate late fee, penalty range and interest for TDS returns and deposits made after the due date. Uses the figures you enter.
tdslate.summary: This tool estimates the late fee for a TDS return, the penalty range and the interest on tax deducted but deposited late. It is used by deductors with late TDS returns or deposits. You need to enter the amount of TDS, the due dates, the dates of deduction and the date of filing, and the result shows the late fee, the interest and the penalty range.
steps: Enter the amount of TDS, the due dates, the dates of deduction and the date of filing.
Choose the type of default to match your situation.
Read the late fee, the interest and the penalty range in the result.
tdslate.note: The late fee is limited to the amount of TDS; the penalty is decided by the officer.

sec192.title: Salary TDS calculator, Section 192
sec192.description: Estimate the monthly tax an employer deducts from salary, on the average rate basis, with declarations considered.
sec192.summary: This tool estimates the monthly tax an employer deducts from salary on the average rate basis, after taking the declarations of the employee into account. It is used by employers, payroll teams and salaried employees. You need to enter the salary, the allowances, the declared deductions and the months remaining, and the result shows the annual tax estimate and the tax to deduct each month.
steps: Enter the salary, the allowances, the declared deductions and the months remaining.
Choose the regime and the declarations to match your situation.
Read the annual tax estimate and the tax to deduct each month in the result.
sec192.note: The deduction depends on the declarations made to the employer; actual tax is settled in the return.

sec192a.title: EPF withdrawal TDS calculator
sec192a.description: Estimate TDS on early withdrawal from a provident fund account, with and without PAN, for the payment year. Uses the figures you enter.
sec192a.summary: This tool estimates the tax deducted when a provident fund balance is withdrawn before five years of service, with and without a valid PAN. It is used by employees who withdraw their provident fund. You need to enter the taxable balance, the years of service and the PAN status, and the result shows whether TDS applies, the rate and the amount.
steps: Enter the taxable balance, the years of service and the PAN status.
Choose the year of payment to match your situation.
Read whether TDS applies, the rate and the amount in the result.
sec192a.note: TDS may not apply for transfers or small amounts; confirm the threshold and the years of service.

panaadhaar.h1: PAN and Aadhaar link status guide
panaadhaar.title: PAN and Aadhaar link status guide
panaadhaar.description: Know the steps for checking the PAN and Aadhaar link on the income tax portal and what to do for each message.
panaadhaar.summary: This tool explains the steps to check whether a PAN is linked with Aadhaar on the income tax portal and what to do for the message you see. It is used by individuals who hold a PAN and an Aadhaar. You need to enter the message shown on the portal when you check the status, and the result shows the next step for that message and the points to keep in mind.
steps: Enter the message shown on the portal when you check the status.
Choose the message you got to match your situation.
Read the next step for that message and the points to keep in mind in the result.
panaadhaar.note: This guide does not verify your PAN; keep the portal confirmation and check the tax effect for the year.

sec194la.title: Compulsory acquisition TDS, Section 194LA
sec194la.description: Calculate TDS on compensation paid for compulsory acquisition of immovable property above the threshold. Uses the figures you enter.
sec194la.summary: This tool calculates the tax deducted on compensation paid for the compulsory acquisition of immovable property where it exceeds the threshold. It is used by authorities that acquire land and recipients of compensation. You need to enter the compensation or enhanced compensation and the type of property, and the result shows whether tax applies and the TDS amount.
steps: Enter the compensation or enhanced compensation and the type of property.
Choose the type of property to match your situation.
Read whether tax applies and the TDS amount in the result.
sec194la.note: Compensation for agricultural land in rural areas is not covered; check the nature of the land.

sec194m.title: Personal payments TDS, Section 194M
sec194m.description: Calculate TDS by individuals and HUFs on payments to contractors and professionals above the annual limit. Uses the figures you enter.
sec194m.summary: This tool calculates the tax deducted by individuals and HUFs, who are not under audit, on payments to contractors and professionals above the limit. It is used by individuals and HUFs who pay contractors, commission or fees. You need to enter the amount paid in the year and the type of payment, and the result shows whether the limit is crossed and the TDS amount.
steps: Enter the amount paid in the year and the type of payment.
Choose the type of payment to match your situation.
Read whether the limit is crossed and the TDS amount in the result.
sec194m.note: A TAN is not needed; check that you are not subject to a tax audit and file the challan on time.

sec194o.title: E-commerce operator TDS calculator
sec194o.description: Estimate TDS on payments to e-commerce participants, checking the year, the seller's status and the base amount.
sec194o.summary: This tool estimates the tax deducted on payments or credits to a resident seller through an e-commerce platform, with checks for threshold and identity. It is used by e-commerce operators and sellers on platforms. You need to enter the annual gross sales, the amount credited and the PAN status of the seller, and the result shows whether the deduction applies, the rate and the amount.
steps: Enter the annual gross sales, the amount credited and the PAN status of the seller.
Choose the year and the status of the seller to match your situation.
Read whether the deduction applies, the rate and the amount in the result.
sec194o.note: This is not the final tax of the seller; check the base amount and exceptional cases.

sec194b.title: Section 194B winnings TDS
sec194b.description: Calculate TDS on winnings from lotteries, games and online gaming, including net winnings in online games. Uses the figures you enter.
sec194b.summary: This tool calculates the tax deducted on winnings from lotteries, games and online gaming, including net winnings from online games. It is used by payers and recipients of winnings. You need to enter the winning amount, the aggregate winnings and, for online games, the deposits and withdrawals, and the result shows the TDS at the flat rate and the net amount paid.
steps: Enter the winning amount, the aggregate winnings and, for online games, the deposits and withdrawals.
Choose the type of game to match your situation.
Read the TDS at the flat rate and the net amount paid in the result.
sec194b.note: Rules differ for online gaming and horse racing; check the type of winning and the date.

sec194lbb.title: Section 194LBB AIF distribution TDS
sec194lbb.description: Calculate TDS on income distributed by Category I and II alternative investment funds to investors. Uses the figures you enter.
sec194lbb.summary: This tool calculates the tax deducted on income distributed by Category I and II alternative investment funds to their unit holders. It is used by fund managers and investors in alternative investment funds. You need to enter the amount distributed and the status of the investor, and the result shows the TDS rate and the amount deducted.
steps: Enter the amount distributed and the status of the investor.
Choose the investor category and any treaty rate to match your situation.
Read the TDS rate and the amount deducted in the result.
sec194lbb.note: Business income is not covered by the deduction; check the nature of the income distributed.

sec194t.title: Partner payment TDS, Section 194T
sec194t.description: Calculate TDS on salary, interest, remuneration and bonus paid by a firm to its partners above the annual limit.
sec194t.summary: This tool calculates the tax deducted by a partnership firm or LLP on salary, remuneration, interest, bonus or commission paid to partners above the limit. It is used by partnership firms, LLPs and their accountants. You need to enter the payments made to each partner in the year and the nature of each payment, and the result shows whether the limit is crossed and the amount of TDS.
steps: Enter the payments made to each partner in the year and the nature of each payment.
Choose the type of payment to match your situation.
Read whether the limit is crossed and the amount of TDS in the result.
sec194t.note: The provision applies from a stated date; check the date of credit or payment.

sec194lbc.title: Securitisation trust TDS, Section 194LBC
sec194lbc.description: Calculate TDS on income distributed by a securitisation trust to investors, by investor type and treaty rate. Uses the figures you enter.
sec194lbc.summary: This tool calculates the tax deducted on income paid by a securitisation trust to its investors, by the investor category and any treaty rate. It is used by securitisation trusts and their investors. You need to enter the amount distributed and the type of investor, and the result shows the TDS rate and the amount deducted.
steps: Enter the amount distributed and the type of investor.
Choose the investor type and the treaty rate to match your situation.
Read the TDS rate and the amount deducted in the result.
sec194lbc.note: Treaty rates need documents such as a residence certificate; confirm them before applying.

form16.title: Form 16 TDS certificate generator
form16.description: Prepare a preview of Form 16 for salary, showing the TDS summary and the computation of the employee's tax. Uses the figures you enter.
form16.summary: This tool prepares a preview of Form 16 for salary income, showing the summary of tax deducted and the computation of Part B. It is used by employers and payroll teams. You need to enter the details of the employer and employee, the salary, the deductions and the tax deducted, and the result shows a Form 16 style preview with the tax computation.
steps: Enter the details of the employer and employee, the salary, the deductions and the tax deducted.
Choose the regime and the deductions to match your situation.
Read a Form 16 style preview with the tax computation in the result.
form16.note: Part A comes from the TDS portal; this is a preview and not a certificate.

sec194c.title: Contractor TDS calculator, Section 194C
sec194c.description: Calculate TDS on payments to contractors and sub-contractors, with single payment and annual limits. Uses the figures you enter.
sec194c.summary: This tool calculates the tax deducted on payments to contractors and sub-contractors, with the single payment and annual limit tests. It is used by businesses and individuals who pay contractors. You need to enter the payment, the total in the year and the type of payee, and the result shows whether the limits are crossed, the rate and the TDS.
steps: Enter the payment, the total in the year and the type of payee.
Choose the type of payee to match your situation.
Read whether the limits are crossed, the rate and the TDS in the result.
sec194c.note: The rate depends on the type of payee; transporters with PAN may have an exemption.

sec194i.title: Rent TDS for businesses, Section 194I
sec194i.description: Calculate TDS on rent for land, building, plant and machinery paid by businesses under audit. Uses the figures you enter.
sec194i.summary: This tool calculates the tax deducted on rent paid by businesses for land, buildings, plant, machinery and equipment, with the limit. It is used by businesses, firms and companies that pay rent. You need to enter the rent paid in the year or month and the type of asset, and the result shows the rate, whether the limit is crossed, and the TDS.
steps: Enter the rent paid in the year or month and the type of asset.
Choose the type of asset to match your situation.
Read the rate, whether the limit is crossed, and the TDS in the result.
sec194i.note: The limit applies on rent paid in the year; confirm the threshold for your payment date.

sec194j.title: Professional fees TDS, Section 194J
sec194j.description: Calculate TDS on professional fees and technical services above the threshold at the rates for each type. Uses the figures you enter.
sec194j.summary: This tool calculates the tax deducted on fees for professional and technical services, applying the rate for each type and the threshold. It is used by businesses and individuals who pay professionals. You need to enter the fee paid, the total in the year and the type of service, and the result shows the rate, whether the limit is crossed and the TDS.
steps: Enter the fee paid, the total in the year and the type of service.
Choose the type of service to match your situation.
Read the rate, whether the limit is crossed and the TDS in the result.
sec194j.note: A different rate applies to some payees; confirm the nature of the service and the threshold.

sec194h.title: Commission TDS calculator, Section 194H
sec194h.description: Calculate TDS on commission or brokerage paid for buying or selling goods and for services. Uses the figures you enter.
sec194h.summary: This tool calculates the tax deducted on commission or brokerage paid for services in the course of buying or selling goods or services. It is used by businesses that pay agents and brokers. You need to enter the commission paid, the total in the year and the PAN status, and the result shows whether the limit is crossed, the rate and the TDS.
steps: Enter the commission paid, the total in the year and the PAN status.
Choose the payment date to match your situation.
Read whether the limit is crossed, the rate and the TDS in the result.
sec194h.note: Some payments are not covered; confirm the nature of the payment and the threshold.

sec194n.title: Cash withdrawal TDS, Section 194N
sec194n.description: Calculate TDS on large cash withdrawals from banks and post offices, which differs for filers and non-filers. Uses the figures you enter.
sec194n.summary: This tool calculates the tax deducted on cash withdrawals from banks, co-operative banks and post offices above the limits for filers and non-filers. It is used by account holders who withdraw large cash amounts. You need to enter the cash withdrawn in the year and whether you have filed returns, and the result shows the limit, the rate and the TDS on the excess.
steps: Enter the cash withdrawn in the year and whether you have filed returns.
Choose your filing status to match your situation.
Read the limit, the rate and the TDS on the excess in the result.
sec194n.note: The TDS is credited in your tax statement; confirm the limit and rate for your category.

sec194ib.title: Rent TDS for individuals, Section 194IB
sec194ib.description: Calculate TDS by an individual or HUF tenant on monthly rent above the limit, without a TAN. Uses the figures you enter.
sec194ib.summary: This tool calculates the tax deducted by an individual or HUF tenant on monthly rent above the limit, without the need for a TAN. It is used by tenants who are individuals or HUFs and not under audit. You need to enter the monthly rent, the number of months and the PAN status, and the result shows whether the limit is crossed, the rate and the TDS.
steps: Enter the monthly rent, the number of months and the PAN status.
Choose the months of rent to match your situation.
Read whether the limit is crossed, the rate and the TDS in the result.
sec194ib.note: The tax is deducted once in the year or at the end of tenancy; file the challan on time.

sec194ia.title: Property purchase TDS estimate
sec194ia.description: Estimate TDS on the purchase of immovable property from a resident seller, on the higher of the consideration and stamp duty value.
sec194ia.summary: This tool estimates the tax deducted by a buyer on purchasing property from a resident seller, using the higher of the consideration and the stamp duty value. It is used by buyers of immovable property. You need to enter the consideration, the stamp duty value and the number of buyers and sellers, and the result shows whether tax applies, the base value and the TDS.
steps: Enter the consideration, the stamp duty value and the number of buyers and sellers.
Choose the number of buyers and sellers to match your situation.
Read whether tax applies, the base value and the TDS in the result.
