sec194ia.note: Instalments, ownership shares and filing forms need separate checking; confirm the seller's residence.

f15gh.title: Form 15G and 15H eligibility checker
f15gh.description: Check whether you can submit Form 15G or 15H to avoid TDS on interest, by answering a few questions. Uses the figures you enter.
f15gh.summary: This tool helps check whether a depositor is eligible to submit a declaration in Form 15G or 15H to avoid tax deduction on interest, through yes or no questions. It is used by depositors and senior citizens with interest income. You need to enter answers to questions on age, income and tax liability, and the result shows whether you appear eligible and which form applies.
steps: Enter answers to questions on age, income and tax liability.
Choose your age and the estimated tax liability to match your situation.
Read whether you appear eligible and which form applies in the result.
f15gh.note: Eligibility depends on total income and nil tax; submitting a wrong declaration has consequences.

cal.title: Compliance calendar
cal.description: Track statutory due dates for income tax, GST, TDS and other filings, with countdowns to the next dates. Uses the figures you enter.
cal.summary: This tool lists statutory due dates for income tax, GST, TDS and other filings, with a countdown to the next dates. It is used by business owners, accountants and individual taxpayers. You need to enter the category of dates you want to follow, and the result shows the upcoming dates with the days remaining and an option to add to your calendar.
steps: Enter the category of dates you want to follow.
Choose the category and the month to match your situation.
Read the upcoming dates with the days remaining and an option to add to your calendar in the result.
cal.note: Dates can be extended by notification; check the portal before relying on a date.

audit.title: Section 44AB tax audit checker
audit.description: Check whether a tax audit is required, the related penalty, and the deadline for the audit report. Uses the figures you enter.
audit.summary: This tool checks whether a tax audit is required based on turnover, receipts and the manner of business, and shows the penalty and the due date. It is used by businesses and professionals with significant turnover. You need to enter the turnover or gross receipts, the cash share and the presumptive scheme details, and the result shows whether an audit applies, the penalty for default and the due date.
steps: Enter the turnover or gross receipts, the cash share and the presumptive scheme details.
Choose the type of assessee and the scheme opted to match your situation.
Read whether an audit applies, the penalty for default and the due date in the result.
audit.note: The limit depends on the cash share; confirm the facts with the audit provisions.

presumptive.title: Presumptive taxation calculator
presumptive.description: Check eligibility for presumptive taxation and compare deemed profit with normal computation for business and professions.
presumptive.summary: This tool checks eligibility for presumptive taxation of businesses, professions and goods carriages and compares the deemed profit with the actual profit. It is used by small businesses, professionals and transporters. You need to enter the turnover or receipts, the actual profit, the vehicle details if any, and the result shows the deemed profit, the actual profit and the scheme limits.
steps: Enter the turnover or receipts, the actual profit, the vehicle details if any.
Choose the scheme that applies to you to match your situation.
Read the deemed profit, the actual profit and the scheme limits in the result.
presumptive.note: Opting out may attract a tax audit and bar you from the scheme for some years; read the conditions.

depreciation.h1: Depreciation calculator under the Income-tax Act
depreciation.title: Income-tax depreciation calculator
depreciation.description: Compute depreciation on up to ten blocks of assets on the written down value method, including additional depreciation.
depreciation.summary: This tool computes depreciation on blocks of assets using the written down value method, with additional depreciation and the half-year rule where it applies. It is used by businesses and professionals with fixed assets. You need to enter the opening block value, the additions, the sales and the rate for each block, and the result shows the depreciation for each block and the closing written down value.
steps: Enter the opening block value, the additions, the sales and the rate for each block.
Choose the block of asset and the date of use to match your situation.
Read the depreciation for each block and the closing written down value in the result.
depreciation.note: Block rates and rules depend on the tax year; confirm the rate and class of each asset.

udyam.title: MSME classification and payment check
udyam.description: Classify an enterprise as micro, small or medium by investment and turnover, and check the payment timeline for MSME suppliers.
udyam.summary: This tool classifies an enterprise as micro, small or medium by investment and turnover, and tests the payment timeline for MSME suppliers. It is used by MSME owners and buyers who purchase from MSMEs. You need to enter the investment in plant and machinery, the turnover and the dates of supply and payment, and the result shows the category, the due date for payment and any amount that may be disallowed.
steps: Enter the investment in plant and machinery, the turnover and the dates of supply and payment.
Choose the type of enterprise to match your situation.
Read the category, the due date for payment and any amount that may be disallowed in the result.
udyam.note: Classification follows the Udyam registration; confirm that the supplier is registered and the dates.

sec43bh.title: MSME 45-day payment rule, Section 43B(h)
sec43bh.description: Check whether payments to micro and small suppliers made late are disallowed in the year, using the 45-day rule.
sec43bh.summary: This tool checks whether an amount payable to a micro or small enterprise is disallowed in the year because it was not paid within the allowed period. It is used by buyers who purchase from micro and small enterprises. You need to enter the invoice amount, the date of supply, the date of payment and any written agreement, and the result shows the due date for payment, the amount disallowed and the year when allowed.
steps: Enter the invoice amount, the date of supply, the date of payment and any written agreement.
Choose the agreed period of credit to match your situation.
Read the due date for payment, the amount disallowed and the year when allowed in the result.
sec43bh.note: The time depends on the written agreement; the supplier must be registered under the MSME law.

sec269su.title: Digital payment modes, Section 269SU
sec269su.description: Check whether a business must offer prescribed electronic modes of payment based on its turnover, and the penalty for default.
sec269su.summary: This tool checks whether a business must provide the prescribed electronic modes of payment, based on its turnover in the preceding year, and the penalty. It is used by businesses with large turnover. You need to enter the turnover, sales or receipts of the preceding year, and the result shows whether the provision applies and the penalty for each day of default.
steps: Enter the turnover, sales or receipts of the preceding year.
Choose the preceding year to match your situation.
Read whether the provision applies and the penalty for each day of default in the result.
sec269su.note: Check the modes of payment that are prescribed and the date from which the rule applies.

penalty.title: Late fee and penalty calculator
penalty.description: Estimate late fees and penalties for income tax returns, TDS and GST, and the interest that accompanies each. Uses the figures you enter.
penalty.summary: This tool estimates late filing fees, penalties and interest for income tax returns, TDS returns and GST returns in one place. It is used by taxpayers and accountants dealing with late filing. You need to enter the tax or fee amount, the due date and the date of filing, and the result shows the late fee, the penalty and the interest for the default chosen.
steps: Enter the tax or fee amount, the due date and the date of filing.
Choose the type of default to match your situation.
Read the late fee, the penalty and the interest for the default chosen in the result.
penalty.note: Penalties are decided by the authority; this tool only estimates the statutory fees and interest.

sec115bbe.title: Unexplained income tax, Section 115BBE
sec115bbe.description: Estimate tax at the special rate on unexplained credits, investments and expenditure, with surcharge and cess.
sec115bbe.summary: This tool estimates the tax at the special rate on unexplained cash credits, investments, money and expenditure, including surcharge and cess. It is used by taxpayers facing additions in assessment and their advisers. You need to enter the amount added to income and any other income of the year, and the result shows the tax on the unexplained income, the surcharge, the cess and the total.
steps: Enter the amount added to income and any other income of the year.
Choose the type of addition to match your situation.
Read the tax on the unexplained income, the surcharge, the cess and the total in the result.
sec115bbe.note: No deduction or set-off is allowed against the income; penalty provisions are separate.

sec270a.title: Under-reporting penalty, Section 270A
sec270a.description: Estimate the penalty on under-reported or misreported income as a percentage of the tax on that income. Uses the figures you enter.
sec270a.summary: This tool estimates the penalty for under-reporting or misreporting of income, as a percentage of the tax payable on the under-reported income. It is used by taxpayers who received an assessment order and their advisers. You need to enter the income returned, the income assessed and the tax on the difference, and the result shows the under-reported income, the tax payable on it and the penalty.
steps: Enter the income returned, the income assessed and the tax on the difference.
Choose the type of default to match your situation.
Read the under-reported income, the tax payable on it and the penalty in the result.
sec270a.note: Exceptions and immunity are available in some cases; check the facts and the order.

cash269.title: Cash transaction limits
cash269.description: Check cash receipts, loans and repayments against the statutory limits and the penalty for default. Uses the figures you enter.
cash269.summary: This tool checks cash receipts, loans, deposits and repayments against the statutory limits and shows the penalty for default. It is used by businesses, professionals and individuals who handle cash. You need to enter the amount of cash, the type of transaction and whether it is a single transaction, and the result shows whether the limit is crossed and the penalty amount.
steps: Enter the amount of cash, the type of transaction and whether it is a single transaction.
Choose the type of transaction to match your situation.
Read whether the limit is crossed and the penalty amount in the result.
cash269.note: Several exceptions exist for banks and governments; check whether your transaction is covered.

cash40a.title: Cash payment disallowance, Section 40A(3)
cash40a.description: Estimate the expenditure disallowed when a business pays above the cash limit to one person in a day. Uses the figures you enter.
cash40a.summary: This tool estimates the expenditure disallowed when a business pays cash above the limit to a single person in a single day. It is used by businesses and professionals under audit. You need to enter the cash payment, the number of payments in a day and your slab rate, and the result shows the amount disallowed and the extra tax.
steps: Enter the cash payment, the number of payments in a day and your slab rate.
Choose the type of payee to match your situation.
Read the amount disallowed and the extra tax in the result.
cash40a.note: A higher limit applies to transport payments; confirm the exceptions listed in the rules.

ais.title: AIS and 26AS reconciliation tool
ais.description: Compare entries from AIS or Form 26AS with the amounts you declared and flag the differences to check. Uses the figures you enter.
ais.summary: This tool compares rows from the Annual Information Statement or Form 26AS with the amounts you plan to declare and flags the differences. It is used by individuals and accountants preparing a return. You need to enter the rows from AIS or 26AS and the amounts in your own records, and the result shows the matched rows, the mismatches and the difference for each.
steps: Enter the rows from AIS or 26AS and the amounts in your own records.
Choose the source and the matching basis to match your situation.
Read the matched rows, the mismatches and the difference for each in the result.
ais.note: Only the rows you paste are compared; confirm each difference against your documents before filing.

tp3ceb.title: Form 3CEB applicability checker
tp3ceb.description: Check whether Form 3CEB, the report on international transactions with associated enterprises, is required for your transactions.
tp3ceb.summary: This tool checks whether Form 3CEB is needed for international transactions with associated enterprises and specified domestic transactions above the limit. It is used by companies and businesses with foreign related parties. You need to enter the value of international transactions and specified domestic transactions, and the result shows whether a report is required and the due date.
steps: Enter the value of international transactions and specified domestic transactions.
Choose whether associated enterprises are involved to match your situation.
Read whether a report is required and the due date in the result.
tp3ceb.note: Associated enterprise status depends on control and shareholding; confirm each relationship.

trustreg.title: Trust registration guide
trustreg.description: Understand the registration cycle for charitable trusts, the forms used and the validity period of each registration.
trustreg.summary: This tool explains the registration of charitable and religious trusts, the forms used and the validity period of each registration. It is used by trustees and accountants of trusts and institutions. You need to enter the stage of the trust: new, existing or renewal, and the result shows the form to use, the validity period and the next date for action.
steps: Enter the stage of the trust: new, existing or renewal.
Choose the stage of registration to match your situation.
Read the form to use, the validity period and the next date for action in the result.
trustreg.note: Registration is granted by the Commissioner; check the current forms and due dates on the portal.

trustapp.title: Trust income application calculator
trustapp.description: Check whether a registered trust has applied the required share of income and see the amount that can be accumulated.
trustapp.summary: This tool checks whether a registered trust has applied the required share of its income for its objects and shows the amount that may be accumulated. It is used by trustees and accountants preparing the return of a trust. You need to enter the income of the year, the amount applied, the capital expenditure and the amounts set aside, and the result shows the required application, the shortfall and the accumulated income.
steps: Enter the income of the year, the amount applied, the capital expenditure and the amounts set aside.
Choose the type of application to match your situation.
Read the required application, the shortfall and the accumulated income in the result.
trustapp.note: Accumulation needs a notice in the prescribed form; check the investment rules for accumulated funds.

emi.title: EMI and loan amortisation calculator
emi.description: Calculate the monthly instalment on a loan, view the repayment schedule and see the effect of prepayments. Uses the figures you enter.
emi.summary: This tool calculates the monthly instalment on a loan, builds the repayment schedule and shows the effect of part prepayments. It is used by borrowers comparing loans and planning repayment. You need to enter the loan amount, the rate of interest, the tenure and any prepayment, and the result shows the instalment, the total interest and the schedule of principal and interest.
steps: Enter the loan amount, the rate of interest, the tenure and any prepayment.
Choose the tenure and the prepayment option to match your situation.
Read the instalment, the total interest and the schedule of principal and interest in the result.
emi.note: Banks may round instalments or change the rate; check the schedule given by your lender.

investments.title: Investment returns calculator
investments.description: Project the value of a SIP, PPF, fixed deposit or NPS investment over your chosen period. Uses the figures you enter.
investments.summary: This tool projects the value of a step-up SIP, PPF deposits, a fixed deposit and an NPS corpus over the chosen period. It is used by savers planning long-term goals. You need to enter the amount invested, the expected rate of return and the number of years, and the result shows the maturity value, the amount invested and the gain.
steps: Enter the amount invested, the expected rate of return and the number of years.
Choose the type of investment and the frequency of investment to match your situation.
Read the maturity value, the amount invested and the gain in the result.
investments.note: Returns are assumed and not certain; rates of PPF and fixed deposits change from time to time.

retirement.title: Retirement corpus calculator
retirement.description: Estimate the corpus needed at retirement to meet expenses that rise with inflation, using a replacement ratio.
retirement.summary: This tool estimates the corpus you need at retirement to meet expenses that rise with inflation, using a replacement ratio for your income. It is used by working individuals planning for retirement. You need to enter your age, retirement age, current expenses, inflation rate and expected return, and the result shows the corpus needed, the monthly saving required and the years remaining.
steps: Enter your age, retirement age, current expenses, inflation rate and expected return.
Choose the inflation and return assumptions to match your situation.
Read the corpus needed, the monthly saving required and the years remaining in the result.
retirement.note: The result depends on assumptions about inflation and return; revise them from time to time.

hlv.title: Life insurance need calculator
hlv.description: Estimate the life cover needed with the human life value and DIME methods, to help size a term insurance cover.
hlv.summary: This tool estimates the life cover a family may need, using the human life value method and the DIME method of debt, income, mortgage and education. It is used by individuals with dependants who plan their insurance. You need to enter your income, age, debts, home loan, children's education needs and existing cover, and the result shows the cover needed by each method and the gap against existing cover.
steps: Enter your income, age, debts, home loan, children's education needs and existing cover.
Choose the method used to match your situation.
Read the cover needed by each method and the gap against existing cover in the result.
hlv.note: This is an estimate and not a recommendation of a policy; consider your family's needs and the terms of the plan.

networth.title: Personal net worth statement
networth.description: Prepare a statement of your assets and liabilities to see your net worth at a point in time. Uses the figures you enter.
networth.summary: This tool prepares a statement of personal assets and liabilities and works out the net worth by deducting liabilities from assets. It is used by individuals who plan finances, apply for loans or prepare disclosures. You need to enter the value of liquid and fixed assets, investments, property and your loans, and the result shows the total assets, the total liabilities and the net worth.
steps: Enter the value of liquid and fixed assets, investments, property and your loans.
Choose the asset and liability categories to match your situation.
Read the total assets, the total liabilities and the net worth in the result.
networth.note: Values are as entered by you and are not valued independently; update them from time to time.

childedu.title: Children's education corpus calculator
childedu.description: Project the future cost of a degree with education inflation and estimate the monthly saving needed to reach it.
childedu.summary: This tool projects the future cost of a degree using an education inflation rate and estimates the saving needed to reach that goal. It is used by parents planning for their children's education. You need to enter the present cost of the course, the child's age, the years to start and the expected return, and the result shows the future cost, the corpus needed and the monthly saving.
steps: Enter the present cost of the course, the child's age, the years to start and the expected return.
Choose the inflation and return assumptions to match your situation.
Read the future cost, the corpus needed and the monthly saving in the result.
childedu.note: Education costs vary widely; use realistic inflation and return figures and revise them from time to time.

sipelss.title: SIP and ELSS comparison calculator
sipelss.description: Compare a SIP or lump sum with an ELSS investment, including long-term gains tax and the tax saved under the old regime.
sipelss.summary: This tool compares the future value of a SIP or lump sum with an ELSS investment, along with the long-term capital gains tax and the deduction under the old regime. It is used by investors who are choosing between funds and tax-saving options. You need to enter the amount invested, the period, the expected return and your slab rate, and the result shows the future value, the tax on gains and the tax saved by the deduction.
steps: Enter the amount invested, the period, the expected return and your slab rate.
Choose the investment mode and the regime to match your situation.
Read the future value, the tax on gains and the tax saved by the deduction in the result.
sipelss.note: Mutual fund returns are not fixed, and ELSS has a lock-in; the deduction is available under the old regime.

sgb.title: Sovereign gold bond calculator
sgb.description: Estimate the interest, redemption value and tax treatment of a sovereign gold bond for the chosen holding period.
sgb.summary: This tool estimates the interest, the redemption or sale value and the tax on a sovereign gold bond, based on the holding period and the buyer. It is used by investors in sovereign gold bonds. You need to enter the grams, the issue value per gram, the sale value per gram, the holding months and your slab rate, and the result shows the interest, the capital gain and the tax.
steps: Enter the grams, the issue value per gram, the sale value per gram, the holding months and your slab rate.
Choose the holding period and the mode of exit to match your situation.
Read the interest, the capital gain and the tax in the result.
sgb.note: The tax treatment depends on whether the bond is redeemed at maturity or sold in the market.

reit.title: REIT and InvIT taxation calculator
reit.description: Split distributions from REITs and InvITs into interest, dividend and return of capital, and estimate the tax.
reit.summary: This tool splits distributions from a REIT or InvIT into interest, dividend and return of capital, and estimates the tax and the gain on sale of units. It is used by investors in real estate and infrastructure trusts. You need to enter the units held, the purchase and sale values per unit and the annual distribution, and the result shows the taxable income, the capital gain and the TDS.
steps: Enter the units held, the purchase and sale values per unit and the annual distribution.
Choose the split of the distribution to match your situation.
Read the taxable income, the capital gain and the TDS in the result.
reit.note: The split is declared by the trust each year; use the figures from its statement.

loandeduct.h1: Education and electric vehicle loan interest deduction
loandeduct.title: Education and EV loan interest deduction
loandeduct.description: Work out the deduction for interest on an education loan and on an electric vehicle loan, subject to the limits.
loandeduct.summary: This tool works out the deduction for interest paid on an education loan and on an electric vehicle loan, subject to the limits of each. It is used by borrowers who repay education or electric vehicle loans. You need to enter the interest paid in the year, the date of loan sanction and the purpose of the loan, and the result shows the deduction allowed under each section and the total.
steps: Enter the interest paid in the year, the date of loan sanction and the purpose of the loan.
Choose the loan type to match your situation.
Read the deduction allowed under each section and the total in the result.
loandeduct.note: These deductions are for the old regime; confirm the conditions on the loan and the lender.

nps.title: NPS corpus and pension calculator
nps.description: Project the National Pension System corpus, the annuity share, the tax-free lump sum and the monthly pension. Uses the figures you enter.
nps.summary: This tool projects the National Pension System corpus at retirement, the share used to buy an annuity, the tax-free lump sum and the monthly pension. It is used by NPS subscribers planning retirement. You need to enter the monthly contribution, the age, the expected return and the annuity share, and the result shows the corpus, the lump sum, the annuity and the monthly pension estimate.
steps: Enter the monthly contribution, the age, the expected return and the annuity share.
Choose the annuity share and the return to match your situation.
Read the corpus, the lump sum, the annuity and the monthly pension estimate in the result.
nps.note: Returns and annuity rates are not fixed; confirm the withdrawal rules in force at retirement.

ppf.title: PPF maturity calculator
ppf.description: Calculate the maturity value of a Public Provident Fund account, including the 15-year term and extensions. Uses the figures you enter.
ppf.summary: This tool calculates the maturity value of a Public Provident Fund account over the 15-year term, with extensions in blocks of five years. It is used by PPF account holders and savers. You need to enter the yearly deposit, the rate of interest, the year of opening and the extensions, and the result shows the balance each year, the interest earned and the maturity value.
steps: Enter the yearly deposit, the rate of interest, the year of opening and the extensions.
Choose the deposit pattern and the extension to match your situation.
Read the balance each year, the interest earned and the maturity value in the result.
ppf.note: The rate is notified each quarter by the Government; deposit within the permitted limits.

pfint.title: Taxable provident fund interest calculator
pfint.description: Work out the taxable interest on employee provident fund contributions above the annual limit. Uses the figures you enter.
pfint.summary: This tool works out the interest on employee contributions to a provident fund that is taxable when the contribution exceeds the annual limit. It is used by employees who contribute a large amount to their provident fund. You need to enter the contribution for the year, the employer contribution, the interest rate and the balance, and the result shows the taxable part of the interest and the non-taxable part.
steps: Enter the contribution for the year, the employer contribution, the interest rate and the balance.
Choose the financial year to match your situation.
Read the taxable part of the interest and the non-taxable part in the result.
pfint.note: The limit differs when the employer makes no contribution; check how your account is split.

eps.title: EPS pension calculator
eps.description: Estimate the monthly pension under the Employees' Pension Scheme from the pensionable salary and service. Uses the figures you enter.
eps.summary: This tool estimates the monthly pension under the Employees' Pension Scheme from the pensionable salary and the period of service. It is used by retiring members of the Employees' Provident Fund. You need to enter the pensionable salary, the years of service and the age at exit, and the result shows the monthly pension estimate and the calculation used.
steps: Enter the pensionable salary, the years of service and the age at exit.
Choose the date of joining to match your situation.
Read the monthly pension estimate and the calculation used in the result.
eps.note: The actual pension is fixed by the EPFO; the wage ceiling and rules depend on the date of joining.

ssy.title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana calculator
ssy.description: Estimate the balance and maturity value of a Sukanya Samriddhi account for the girl child over the full term. Uses the figures you enter.
ssy.summary: This tool estimates the balance and the maturity value of a Sukanya Samriddhi account over the deposit period and up to maturity. It is used by parents and guardians of a girl child. You need to enter the yearly deposit, the girl's age at opening and the interest rate, and the result shows the balance each year, the interest earned and the maturity value.
steps: Enter the yearly deposit, the girl's age at opening and the interest rate.
Choose the age of the girl and the deposit pattern to match your situation.
Read the balance each year, the interest earned and the maturity value in the result.
ssy.note: The rate is notified each quarter; check the rules on deposits, partial withdrawal and closure.

scss.title: Senior citizens savings scheme calculator
scss.description: Calculate quarterly interest and total returns on a Senior Citizens Savings Scheme deposit, with the maturity and extension.
scss.summary: This tool calculates the quarterly interest and total return on a deposit in the Senior Citizens Savings Scheme, with the maturity and extension. It is used by senior citizens and retirees looking for regular interest. You need to enter the deposit amount, the rate of interest and the term, and the result shows the quarterly interest, the total interest and the maturity amount.
steps: Enter the deposit amount, the rate of interest and the term.
Choose the deposit amount and whether you extend to match your situation.
Read the quarterly interest, the total interest and the maturity amount in the result.
scss.note: The interest is taxable and TDS applies above a limit; the deposit limit is set by the scheme.

nri.title: NRI residential status checker
nri.description: Estimate the residential status of an individual based on days of stay in India during the year and earlier years.
nri.summary: This tool estimates the residential status of an individual from the number of days spent in India in the year and in earlier years. It is used by individuals who live or work abroad and visit India. You need to enter the dates of each stay in India, your citizenship and the income from India, and the result shows the likely residential status and the day-count test that applied.
steps: Enter the dates of each stay in India, your citizenship and the income from India.
Choose your citizenship and India-sourced income to match your situation.
Read the likely residential status and the day-count test that applied in the result.
nri.note: Confirm the status and the treaty position with your records; the status is decided for each year.

nrirepat.title: NRO and NRE repatriation guide
nrirepat.description: Check repatriation limits from NRO accounts, and find which forms are needed for remittances abroad. Uses the figures you enter.
nrirepat.summary: This tool checks the limit for repatriating funds from an NRO account and shows which of Form 15CA and Form 15CB applies to the remittance. It is used by NRIs who send money out of India. You need to enter the amount, the nature of the remittance, the account type and the amount remitted in the year, and the result shows the repatriation limit, the forms needed and the points to confirm.
steps: Enter the amount, the nature of the remittance, the account type and the amount remitted in the year.
Choose the account and the purpose of the remittance to match your situation.
Read the repatriation limit, the forms needed and the points to confirm in the result.
nrirepat.note: A certificate from an accountant may be needed; check the exchange control rules and the bank's requirements.

dtaa.title: DTAA withholding rate finder
dtaa.description: Look up indicative withholding tax rates for payments to non-residents under India's tax treaties. Uses the figures you enter.
dtaa.summary: This tool looks up indicative withholding rates for payments to non-residents under India's tax treaties and compares them with the domestic rate. It is used by businesses that pay non-residents and non-resident recipients. You need to enter the country, the type of payment and the amount, and the result shows the treaty rate, the domestic rate and the lower rate.
steps: Enter the country, the type of payment and the amount.
Choose the country and the type of income to match your situation.
Read the treaty rate, the domestic rate and the lower rate in the result.
dtaa.note: The rates are indicative; check the treaty text, the protocol and the documents needed to claim the rate.

ftc.h1: Foreign tax credit calculator for Form 67
ftc.title: Foreign tax credit calculator
ftc.description: Work out the foreign tax credit as the lower of foreign tax paid and Indian tax on the same income. Uses the figures you enter.
ftc.summary: This tool works out the foreign tax credit as the lower of the foreign tax paid and the Indian tax on the same income. It is used by residents of India with income taxed in another country. You need to enter the foreign income, the foreign tax paid and the Indian tax on that income, and the result shows the credit allowed and the excess foreign tax that is not allowed.
steps: Enter the foreign income, the foreign tax paid and the Indian tax on that income.
Choose the country and the type of income to match your situation.
Read the credit allowed and the excess foreign tax that is not allowed in the result.
ftc.note: Form 67 must be filed before the return and the amount must be converted at the prescribed rate.

sec195.h1: TDS on payments to non-residents, Section 195
sec195.title: Section 195 TDS on non-residents
sec195.description: Estimate TDS on payments to non-residents under the Act or a treaty, with the higher rate where no PAN is given.
sec195.summary: This tool estimates the tax to be deducted on payments to non-residents under the domestic law or under a treaty, with the higher rate when no PAN is given. It is used by businesses that make payments abroad and their accountants. You need to enter the amount paid, the nature of the payment, the country and the treaty documents, and the result shows the rate applied, the tax to deduct and the grossed up amount.
steps: Enter the amount paid, the nature of the payment, the country and the treaty documents.
Choose the country and whether you apply the treaty to match your situation.
Read the rate applied, the tax to deduct and the grossed up amount in the result.
sec195.note: Forms 15CA and 15CB may be needed; check the taxability of the payment before deducting.

form10f.title: Form 10F declaration guide
form10f.description: Understand when a non-resident must furnish Form 10F with a tax residency certificate to claim a treaty benefit.
form10f.summary: This tool explains when a non-resident has to furnish Form 10F with a tax residency certificate in order to claim a treaty benefit. It is used by non-residents claiming treaty benefits and the payers who deduct tax. You need to enter whether a certificate was issued and the details it contains, and the result shows whether Form 10F is needed and the details to fill in.
steps: Enter whether a certificate was issued and the details it contains.
Choose whether the certificate has the needed details to match your situation.
Read whether Form 10F is needed and the details to fill in in the result.
form10f.note: The form is filed electronically; check the current requirements on the portal.

schedfa.h1: Schedule FA foreign asset disclosure guide
schedfa.title: Schedule FA foreign asset guide
schedfa.description: Check which foreign assets and income must be reported in the return of a resident, and the penalty for non-disclosure.
schedfa.summary: This tool checks which foreign assets and foreign income a resident and ordinarily resident individual must report in the return, and the penalty for non-disclosure. It is used by residents of India who hold foreign bank accounts, shares or property. You need to enter the type of asset, the value and the peak balance, and the result shows whether disclosure is needed and the schedules to fill in.
steps: Enter the type of asset, the value and the peak balance.
Choose the type of asset to match your situation.
Read whether disclosure is needed and the schedules to fill in in the result.
schedfa.note: Disclosure is separate from taxation; check the limits and the calendar year of reporting.

rentreceipt.title: Rent receipt generator
rentreceipt.description: Generate a set of twelve monthly rent receipts as proof of rent for HRA, with the landlord's details. Uses the figures you enter.
rentreceipt.summary: This tool generates a set of twelve monthly rent receipts that can be submitted to an employer as proof of rent for a house rent allowance claim. It is used by salaried tenants who claim HRA. You need to enter the tenant and landlord names, the address, the monthly rent and the period, and the result shows twelve printable receipts for the period.
steps: Enter the tenant and landlord names, the address, the monthly rent and the period.
Choose the months of rent to match your situation.
Read twelve printable receipts for the period in the result.
rentreceipt.note: The landlord's PAN is needed when the yearly rent crosses the limit; only generate receipts for rent actually paid.

validator.h1: PAN, GSTIN and IFSC format validator
validator.title: PAN, GSTIN, TAN and IFSC validator
validator.description: Check the format and checksum of a PAN, GSTIN, TAN, IFSC or Aadhaar number offline, without storing any data. Uses the figures you enter.
validator.summary: This tool checks the format and the checksum of a PAN, GSTIN, TAN, IFSC or Aadhaar number on your device, without sending the number anywhere. It is used by accountants and businesses who verify details before use. You need to enter the number you want to check, and the result shows whether the format and the checksum are valid.
steps: Enter the number you want to check in the fields provided.
Choose the type of number to match your situation.
Read whether the format and the checksum are valid in the result.
validator.note: A valid format does not mean that the number is issued or active; verify it on the official portal.
